name: c12-check
description: Step C12 books check: 360 s at MAX (seed 5) through oil, emulsion and soap springs, N (60 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s), G (200 s), a resize back (220 s), new springs of every kind (240 s), the oil's switches at runtime (260 to 310 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (330 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.25, v.cssH * 0.3, 'oil', 100); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.25, v.cssH * 0.7, 'emulsion', 100); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.75, v.cssH * 0.7, 'soap', 100); return moire.matter.springs.length
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.3, 'emulsion', 200); return 1

{ const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'oil'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.7, 'soap'); } return moire.matter.springs.length
moire.oil.params.phase = true; moire.oil.params.amphi = false; return 'phase on, amphi off'
moire.oil.params.amphi = true; moire.oil.params.fusion = false; return 'amphi on, fusion off'
moire.oil.params.fusion = true; moire.oil.params.on = false; return 'fusion on, oil off'
moire.oil.params.on = true; moire.oil.params.polarity = true; return 'oil on, polarity view'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
